limitations: The 5000 ms SDK warning remains unexplained. No production timeout change, lock bypass or warning suppression is made.
A descriptor identity change supports a timer-global replacement hypothesis. Stable identities do not distinguish an unobserved client from missed cancellation or unexpected callback delivery.
Function identity does not expose underlying native timer registry or observe individual timer creation/cancellation/firing.

Installed distribution provenance does not attest the final Metro bundle or APK. No such artifact is retained by the previous run.
The observer adds bounded inspection, promise and filesystem overhead; its timings are diagnostic and not uninstrumented production performance.

bounds.retention: First 512 startup events plus most recent 512 events, with dropped-event count.
bounds.pendingPolicy: Replace with latest snapshot while one serialized write is pending. A failed write does not block the latest snapshot.
